    About me

    I am a Ph.D. student (2021 - ) in CSE, CUHK, supervised by Prof. Qi Dou. I received the B.Eng. degree from ISEE, ZJU in 2021, under the supervison from Prof. Honggang Zhang. I was very lucky to do research with Prof. Nenggan Zheng in ZJU, Prof. Pengtao Xie in UCSD, Prof. Jing Qin in HKPolyU.

    Out of research, I have been a technical staff at CC98 Forum, maintaining the community when he was an undergraduate. Besides, I served as a student volunteer at Hangzhou East Railway Station, providing services to passengers during winter in 2018.

    Research Interests

    My research interests lie in computer vision and machine learning, specifically, aiming to improve the Out-of-Distribution (OoD) generalization ability of deep models. Recently, I am investigating artificial intelligence generated content (AIGC), such as realistic videos and human poses.
